To'lovlarni E-POS fiskal moduli orqali s: Send payments to the tax authority through the E-POS fiscal module and print the tax QR code on receipts — per branch
Chek chiqdi, lekin fiskal chek yuborilma: Receipt printed, but the fiscal receipt was not sent: {{error}}
Chekni tekshirish: QR kodni skanerlang (: Verify the receipt: scan the QR code (soliq.uz)
17 xonali — bo'sh bo'lsa filial standart: 17 digits — if empty, the branch default is used
Shu kompyuterda fiskal modul bor: This computer has a fiscal module
Belgilansa, fiskal cheklar shu kompyuter: When checked, fiscal receipts are sent through E-POS on this computer
Z-hisobot — fiskal smena yopiladi va sol: Z-report — the fiscal shift is closed and sent to the tax authority
Do'kon — o'z kodi yo'q mahsulotlar: Shop — products without their own code
Yoqilsa, shu filialdagi har bir to'lov E: When enabled, every payment in this branch is sent to the tax authority through the E-POS fiscal module and the receipt carries the tax link as a QR code. When disabled, everything works as before. This setting applies to this branch only.
E-POS Communicator kassa kompyuterida is: E-POS Communicator runs on the cashier computer, with the fiscal module connected to it over USB.
Brauzerdan — kassa kompyuteridagi E-POS: From the browser — E-POS on the cashier computer
Server orqali — internetdagi manzil: Through the server — an internet address
Bu belgi har bir kompyuterda alohida saq: This flag is stored separately on each computer: only the marked cashier computer sends fiscal receipts. Payments taken on other devices (phone, another computer) go to the queue and are sent from this cashier computer.
Chek sarlavhasida chiqadi — soliq talabi: Printed in the receipt header — a tax requirement.
Kodlar tasnif.soliq.uz saytidan olinadi:: Codes come from tasnif.soliq.uz: IKPU is 17 digits, with a package (unit) code next to it. A kind left empty uses the room charge code. A shop product's own code is entered in the product dialog.
Chek yuborishda smena yopiq bo'lsa, o'zi: If the shift is closed when a receipt is sent, it opens by itself. Closing (Z-report) is done daily from the “Fiscal” button at the top.
Fiskal chekni E-POS o'zi chop etsin: Let E-POS print the fiscal receipt itself
O'chiq bo'lsa (tavsiya etiladi) — chekni: When off (recommended), the system prints the receipt itself with the tax QR code. When on, E-POS also prints its own receipt. Refund and advance receipts are always printed by E-POS.
O'chiq bo'lsa har bir to'lov sotuv cheki: When off, every payment becomes a sale receipt. Agree with your accountant whether to turn this on.
Chekni navbatdan olib tashlash sababi:: Reason for removing the receipt from the queue:
Hali fiskal chek yo'q — to'lov olinganda: No fiscal receipts yet — they appear here once a payment is taken
E-POS serveriga ulanib bo'lmadi: Could not reach the E-POS server
E-POS bilan aloqa yo'q — shu kompyuterda: No connection to E-POS — check that E-POS Communicator is running on this computer
Fiskal modul kompyuterga ulanmagan: The fiscal module is not connected to the computer
Fiskal smena allaqachon ochiq: The fiscal shift is already open
Fiskal smenada sotuv bo'lmagan — yopib b: The fiscal shift has no sales — it cannot be closed
Kassa raqami mavjud emas — E-POS xizmati: Cash register number unavailable — there may be an unpaid E-POS service fee
Fiskal modul drayveri ishlamayapti: The fiscal module driver is not running
Fiskal smena ochilmagan: The fiscal shift is not open
Fiskal smena 24 soatdan oshgan — yopib,: The fiscal shift is older than 24 hours — close it and open a new one
E-POS javobida fiskal belgi yo'q: The E-POS response has no fiscal sign
Bu IKPU uchun o'ram kodi topilmadi — kod: No package code found for this IKPU — check the code
O'ram kodlarini E-POS'dan olish (avval 1: Fetch package codes from E-POS (enter the 17-digit IKPU first)
E-POS tokenini olib bo'lmadi: Could not get the E-POS token
Almashtirish uchun yangi tokenni kiritin: Enter a new token to replace it
E-POS bergan tokenni kiriting: Enter the token issued by E-POS
Tokenni E-POS beradi — har kompaniya va: E-POS issues the token — each company and branch has its own. It is stored encrypted in the database and is never shown here again (only the last 4 characters).
E-POS token kiritilmagan — fiskal chekla: The E-POS token is not set — fiscal receipts are not sent. The configurator enters it in Settings → “Fiscal module (E-POS)”.
